content: Expo Push Notification HTTP API: POST https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send. Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json. Body: {to: 'ExponentPushToken[...]', title: 'string', body: 'string', data: {leadId: '...'}, sound: 'default', channelId: 'default'}. Response: {data: [{status: 'ok', id: '...'}]}. Batch up to 100 messages per request by passing array. Rate limit: 600 requests/minute. Use httpx.AsyncClient directly in FastAPI — no Python SDK needed. Pattern used in project: existing httpx.AsyncClient pattern in escalation_service.py for Resend API calls — same pattern applies here.
